script: f(){ return "$1"; }; f 1 & a=$!; f 2 & b=$!; while kill -0 $a 2>/dev/null || kill -0 $b 2>/dev/null; do sleep 0.01; done; jobs >/dev/null; jobs %2 >/dev/null; wait %1 2>/dev/null; echo "job1=$?"; wait "$a"; echo "pid=$?"
output:
bash: line 1: jobs: %2: no such job
job1=127
pid=1

script: /bin/sh -c 'exit 1' & a=$!; /bin/sh -c 'exit 2' & b=$!; for q in $a $b; do /bin/sh -c 'until [ ! -e "/proc/$1" ] || [ "$(cut -d " " -f 3 "/proc/$1/stat" 2>/dev/null)" = Z ]; do :; done' sh "$q"; done; jobs >/dev/null; jobs %2 >/dev/null; wait %1 2>/dev/null; echo "job1=$?"; wait "$a"; echo "pid=$?"
output:
bash: line 1: jobs: %2: no such job
job1=127
pid=1
